def checked_add(a: int, b: int) -> int | None:
    """Return a + b, or None when the sum falls outside the signed 64-bit range."""
    pre a >= -9223372036854775808 and a <= 9223372036854775807
    ex checked_add(1, 2) == 3
    ex checked_add(-5, 5) == 0
    ex checked_add(9223372036854775807, 1) is None
    ex checked_add(-9223372036854775808, -1) is None
    if b > 0 and a > 9223372036854775807 - b:
        return None
    if b < 0 and a < -9223372036854775808 - b:
        return None
    return a + b
